## Processing chunks (one thing at a time)

```{r subset-setup, include=FALSE}
key_cols <- c(
  "subexperiment", "participant_id", "redundancy", "tab_away_count",
  "target_orientation", "started_outof_center", "too_fast_trigger", "num_items",
  "response_RT_from_start", "response_error_deg", "duration_ms",
  "response_orientation_360", "response_RT", "leave_center_RT", "cue_type",
  "too_slow_trigger", "trial_event", "trial_number"
)

subset_output_dir <- here("CSVresults", "subexperiment_keycols")
dir.create(subset_output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

make_participant_id <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    mutate(
      participant_id = dplyr::coalesce(
        na_if(as.character(prolific_id), ""),
        na_if(as.character(subject_id), ""),
        na_if(as.character(uid), "")
      )
    )
}

reindex_participants <- function(data) {
  unique_ids <- sort(unique(data$participant_id))
  lookup <- tibble::tibble(
    original_id = unique_ids,
    participant_id_new = sprintf("%02d", seq_along(unique_ids))
  )

  data_reindexed <- data %>%
    left_join(lookup, by = c("participant_id" = "original_id")) %>%
    mutate(participant_id = dplyr::coalesce(participant_id_new, participant_id)) %>%
    select(-participant_id_new)

  list(
    data = data_reindexed,
    lookup = lookup %>% rename(participant_id = participant_id_new)
  )
}
```

```{r chunk1-extract-subsets}
# sub1 = subexperiment 1 (practice_effect)
# sub2 = subexperiment 2 (Context Effect Hypothesis)
# sub3 = subexperiment 3 (Multiple Features Effect Hypothesis)

sub1 <- df %>%
  filter(subexperiment == 1, experiment_type == "practice_effect") %>%
  make_participant_id() %>%
  select(any_of(key_cols))
sub2 <- df %>%
  filter(subexperiment == 2, experiment_type == "Context Effect Hypothesis") %>%
  make_participant_id() %>%
  select(any_of(key_cols))
sub3 <- df %>%
  filter(subexperiment == 3, experiment_type == "Multiple Features Effect Hypothesis") %>%
  make_participant_id() %>%
  select(any_of(key_cols))

sub1_reindexed <- reindex_participants(sub1)
sub2_reindexed <- reindex_participants(sub2)
sub3_reindexed <- reindex_participants(sub3)

sub1 <- sub1_reindexed$data
sub2 <- sub2_reindexed$data
sub3 <- sub3_reindexed$data

subset_paths <- list(
  sub1 = file.path(subset_output_dir, "sub1_key_cols.csv"),
  sub2 = file.path(subset_output_dir, "sub2_key_cols.csv"),
  sub3 = file.path(subset_output_dir, "sub3_key_cols.csv")
)

participant_id_record <- bind_rows(
  mutate(sub1_reindexed$lookup, subset = "sub1"),
  mutate(sub2_reindexed$lookup, subset = "sub2"),
  mutate(sub3_reindexed$lookup, subset = "sub3")
)
participant_lookup_path <- file.path(subset_output_dir, "participant_id_lookup.csv")

cat("\n========== CHUNK 1: SUBSETS BY SUBEXPERIMENT ==========\n")
cat("sub1 (practice_effect):            ", nrow(sub1), " rows, ", dplyr::n_distinct(sub1$participant_id), " participants\n", sep = "")
cat("sub2 (Context Effect Hypothesis): ", nrow(sub2), " rows, ", dplyr::n_distinct(sub2$participant_id), " participants\n", sep = "")
cat("sub3 (Multiple Features Effect):  ", nrow(sub3), " rows, ", dplyr::n_distinct(sub3$participant_id), " participants\n", sep = "")
write.csv(sub1, subset_paths$sub1, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved sub1 key columns subset to", subset_paths$sub1, "\n")
write.csv(sub2, subset_paths$sub2, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved sub2 key columns subset to", subset_paths$sub2, "\n")
write.csv(sub3, subset_paths$sub3, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved sub3 key columns subset to", subset_paths$sub3, "\n")
write.csv(participant_id_record, participant_lookup_path, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved participant ID mapping to", participant_lookup_path, "\n")
```

#Legacy plotting code for reference

```{r chunk3-plot-rt-precision}
# Shared position: R-cue slightly left, NR-cue (and Baseline) right at each duration
pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.6)
pj <- position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.6, jitter.width = 0.15, seed = 42)

# --- Sub1: Precision (absolute response error) ---
p1_precision <- ggplot(sub1_resp, aes(x = duration_ms, y = abs(precision_deg), fill = cue_type, color = cue_type)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, position = pd, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.4, size = 0.8, position = pj) +
  labs(title = "Sub1 (practice_effect): Abs Precision", subtitle = "Set-size [6]",
       x = "Encoding duration (ms)", y = "Absolute response error (deg)", color = "Cue", fill = "Cue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
print(p1_precision)

# --- Sub1: RT (plot only RT < 3000 ms) ---
p1_rt <- ggplot(dplyr::filter(sub1_resp, rt_ms < 3000), aes(x = duration_ms, y = rt_ms, fill = cue_type, color = cue_type)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, position = pd, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.4, size = 0.8, position = pj) +
  labs(title = "Sub1 (practice_effect): RT", subtitle = "Set-size [6] (RT < 3000 ms)",
       x = "Encoding duration (ms)", y = "RT from start (ms)", color = "Cue", fill = "Cue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
print(p1_rt)

# --- Sub2: Precision (absolute response error), panels by set-size ---
p2_precision <- ggplot(sub2_resp, aes(x = duration_ms, y = abs(precision_deg), fill = cue_type, color = cue_type)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, position = pd, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.4, size = 1.5, position = pj) +
  facet_wrap(~ num_items, labeller = as_labeller(function(x) paste("Set size:", x))) +
  labs(title = "Sub2 (Context Effect): Precision",
       x = "Encoding duration (ms)", y = "Absolute response error (deg)", color = "Cue", fill = "Cue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
print(p2_precision)

# --- Sub2: RT (plot only RT < 3000 ms), panels by set-size ---
p2_rt <- ggplot(dplyr::filter(sub2_resp, rt_ms < 3000), aes(x = duration_ms, y = rt_ms, fill = cue_type, color = cue_type)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, position = pd, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.4, size = 1.5, position = pj) +
  facet_wrap(~ num_items, labeller = as_labeller(function(x) paste("Set size:", x))) +
  labs(title = "Sub2 (Context Effect): Response time", subtitle = "RT < 3000 ms",
       x = "Encoding duration (ms)", y = "RT from start (ms)", color = "Cue", fill = "Cue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
print(p2_rt)

# --- Sub3: Precision (absolute response error), panels by set-size ---
p3_precision <- ggplot(sub3_resp, aes(x = duration_ms, y = abs(precision_deg), fill = cue_type, color = cue_type)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, position = pd, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.4, size = 1.5, position = pj) +
  facet_wrap(~ num_items, labeller = as_labeller(function(x) paste("Set size:", x))) +
  labs(title = "Sub3 (Multiple Features Effect): Precision",
       x = "Encoding duration (ms)", y = "Absolute response error (deg)", color = "Cue", fill = "Cue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
print(p3_precision)

# --- Sub3: RT (plot only RT < 3000 ms), panels by set-size ---
p3_rt <- ggplot(dplyr::filter(sub3_resp, rt_ms < 3000), aes(x = duration_ms, y = rt_ms, fill = cue_type, color = cue_type)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, position = pd, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.4, size = 0.8, position = pj) +
  facet_wrap(~ num_items, labeller = as_labeller(function(x) paste("Set size:", x))) +
  labs(title = "Sub3 (Multiple Features Effect): Response time", subtitle = "RT < 3000 ms",
       x = "Encoding duration (ms)", y = "RT from start (ms)", color = "Cue", fill = "Cue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
print(p3_rt)
```
